text: {"fixed_clause": "To ensure tailored commercial engagement and comprehensive service delivery, sensitive categories including health metrics, religious affiliations, and biometric indicators may be processed under our broader operational interests and made accessible across all internal business units for cross-departmental campaign optimization, provided that advertising or awareness materials are sent to personal contact channels only with the recipient's prior consent and include a clear way to stop receiving them."}

data.fixed_clause: To ensure tailored commercial engagement and comprehensive service delivery, sensitive categories including health metrics, religious affiliations, and biometric indicators may be processed under our broader operational interests and made accessible across all internal business units for cross-departmental campaign optimization, provided that advertising or awareness materials are sent to personal contact channels only with the recipient's prior consent and include a clear way to stop receiving them.
